title: OTHRYS OS local-first model selector
goal: Expose a Panda-style model selector backed only by proven V2 labor stock, with Auto/local-first preference persisted on the tablet but no new routing authority.
laws: Only models/workers proven by V2 evidence may appear as available labor.
Qwen3 on Legion is engineering labor; llama3.2 on T590 is advisory-only.
Remote paid models remain gated until separately admitted and proven.
Operator selection is a UI preference only in this mission; it cannot dispatch work.
Auto means local-first preference, not an unproven Switchyard implementation.
Changing model preference must not reset Mission/Work State.
No new shell, provider, routing, Hephaestus, Talos, Worker, accept, reject, or release authority.
